customManagers.description: CMake's releases (vX.Y.Z). No hash to move: build/build-cmake.sh verifies the tarball against Kitware's own published cmake-<v>-SHA-256.txt, and CI builds it, so a bump is gated on green like any other.
clang22 N-1: release N of a family product is built by the previous clang22 release, so clang22 may itself depend on this cmake without a cycle.
